s2.ptxt: Install the front seat inner belt assembly RH with the nut.

atten3.ptxt: Install the front seat inner belt assembly RH so that it does not ride up on the locator.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Seat Inner Belt Assembly RH (w/ Manual Seat)

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Seat Assembly RH (w/ Power Seat)

s2.ptxt: Place the front seat assembly RH in the vehicle, and align the adjuster pins with the holes on the vehicle side.
Connect the connectors.
Connect the battery negative terminal.
Operate the power seat switch knob (for slide & vertical) to move the front seat assembly RH to the rearmost position.
Temporarily install the front side of the front seat assembly RH with the 2 bolts.
Operate the power seat switch knob (for slide & vertical) to move the front seat assembly RH to the frontmost position.
Temporarily install the rear side of the front seat assembly RH with the 2 bolts.
Tighten the 2 rear side bolts of the front seat assembly RH in the order of inner → outer.
Operate the power seat switch knob (for slide & vertical) to move the front seat assembly RH to the rearmost position.
Tighten the 2 front side bolts of the front seat assembly RH.
Operate the power seat switch knob (for slide & vertical) to move the front seat assembly RH to the frontmost position.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Seat Assembly RH (w/ Manual Seat)

s2.ptxt: Place the front seat assembly RH in the vehicle, and align the adjuster pins with the holes on the vehicle side.
Operate the seat track handle to move the front seat assembly RH to the rearmost position.
Temporarily install the front side of the front seat assembly RH with the 2 bolts.
Operate the seat track handle to move the front seat assembly RH to the frontmost position.
Temporarily install the rear side of the front seat assembly RH with the 2 bolts.
Tighten the 2 rear side bolts of the front seat assembly RH in the order of inner → outer.
Operate the seat track handle to move the front seat assembly RH to the rearmost position.
Tighten the 2 front side bolts of the front seat assembly RH.
Connect the connectors.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Slide Adjuster Lock Synchronization (w/ Manual Seat)

s2.ptxt: Check that the left and right adjusters lock at the same time when the seat is slid.
If the slide is not synchronized, loosen the seat set bolts and adjust.

s2.ptxt: Engage the 2 claws to install the seat track bracket cover inner RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Seat Track Bracket Cover Inner RH (w/ Manual Seat)

s2.ptxt: Operate the seat track handle to move the front seat assembly RH to the frontmost position.
Insert the guide
Engage the claws to install the seat track bracket cover inner RH.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Power Seat Operation (w/ Power Seat)

s2.ptxt: Check that each adjustment function (slide, front vertical, rear lifter, reclining) operates when each power seat switch is operated.
Check that the warning light comes on when the IG is turned ON.
Check that the warning light goes off approximately 6 seconds after the IG is turned ON.

item.ptxt: If the warning light remains on even after approximately 6 seconds have elapsed after the IG is turned ON, there is a malfunction in the airbag/pretensioner system.

If the light comes on occasionally even after approximately 6 seconds have elapsed after the IG is turned ON, a short to +B, short to ground or open circuit in the airbag warning light circuit may be the cause.
If the light comes on even with the IG OFF or ACC ON, a malfunction in the power supply system or combination meter assembly may be the cause.
